hero.title: The Future Patient
hero.subtitle: Diagnostics × AI × Implantology
hero.lead: Make risks visible. Sharpen decisions. Act earlier. An evening for dentistry and implantology – live at NIO House Berlin on Kurfürstendamm.

claim.title: See more. Plan smarter. Act earlier.
claim.text: The future patient does not become a case in the operating room – they are identified, planned and accompanied beforehand. Three perspectives, one evening: diagnostics, AI-assisted planning and digital action.

pillars.title: Diagnostics
pillars.subtitle: Identify the risk
pillars.text: Make systemic risk factors visible chairside – before they determine treatment success.

pillars.title: AI Planning
pillars.subtitle: Strengthen judgement
pillars.text: AI accelerates planning and makes it more precise. The clinical judgement remains the decision.

pillars.title: Digital Action
pillars.subtitle: Act earlier
pillars.text: From finding to action: navigated, documented and tangible in the workflow.

programme.title: One Patient Journey.
programme.text: An evening along the patient journey: from systemic risk via biomarkers and AI planning to the decision – and then into conversation.

items.title: Use biomarkers

items.title: Plan with AI
items.text: Nobel Biocare · AI in Implant Planning

items.speaker: Dr. med. dent. Bastian Wessing
items.title: Systemic risks. Visible beforehand.
items.claim: See the risk before you place.
items.text: Implant success begins before surgery. The SBIO – Systemic Risk Profile makes modifiable factors such as vitamin D and HbA1c visible before placement.

items.speaker: Dr. Jens Nolte
items.title: Biomarkers. Chairside. Actionable.
items.text: aMMP-8 reveals active inflammation, vitamin D3 regenerative readiness. Finding → conversation → action – directly in the practice, without a detour via the lab.

items.speaker: Nobel Biocare
items.title: AI plans. Clinicians decide.
items.claim: The algorithm accelerates. Clinical judgement decides.
items.text: Value: faster, more precise planning. Limits: clinical judgement stays central. Navigation: AI becomes tangible in the workflow – from planning to guided placement.

live.title: Test. Plan. Navigate. Decide.
live.text: Four stations, one case: test chairside, plan with AI, navigate digitally and decide clinically.
live.challenge_text: To close, you decide the case – finding, planning, action – together with speakers and partners.
